secrets.name: The Room in the Middle
secrets.text: The fog stops at the false bookcase as if it were a wall. Inside it is bright and dry and perfectly still, and there is a desk with a map of the maze on it, drawn by someone who never finished.

meta.label: The Fog Maze
meta.blurb: The stacks go up into fog and the aisles go off into fog. Somewhere in the middle there is a light. There is always a light in the middle.
